company.name: Rocket
company.shortDescription: Rocket is a vibe-coding company that offers production-ready apps possible with a single prompt..
company.description:
WHAT IS ROCKET?

Rocket (https://rocket.new) is the world’s most advanced vibe coding tool—a new way to build apps that’s as easy as speaking an idea out loud.
In one sentence, you describe what you want and Rocket gives you a complete, fully functional, beautifully designed product. No scaffolding. No fiddling with menus. No wrestling with components.

Whether you’re:
- A solopreneur creating an app around a wild idea
- An entrepreneur building a SaaS application
- A product manager designing internal tools
- A student crafting a portfolio

Rocket gets you from vision to production-grade build better than anything else on the internet.
> One idea in. One complete product out.

WHAT YOU CAN BUILD WITH ROCKET?

Rocket adapts to your imagination. It’s not just for landing pages.

You can build:
- Landing pages with modern animations and responsive design
- Dashboards with real-time logic
- Internal tools with backend integration
- Portfolios and personal websites
- AI-powered utilities
- Full-stack SaaS apps with monetized products
